en: The Section on Full Understanding (Pariññāvāra) He who fully understands bodily volitional formation also fully understands verbal volitional formation? Yes.
Or, he who fully understands the verbal formation also fully understands the bodily formation? Yes.
(Just as the section on full understanding was analyzed in the *Khandha-yamaka*, so too should the section on full understanding be analyzed in the *Saṅkhāra-yamaka*.
The Saṅkhāra Yamaka Pāḷi is finished.
